adjustment_reversals_decision.name: adjustment_reversals_decision
adjustment_reversals_decision.value:
("adjustment_reversals"."status" = 'pending' AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("adjustment_reversals"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_by" <> "adjustment_reversals"."requested_by")
      OR ("adjustment_reversals"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_by" = "adjustment_reversals"."requested_by" AND "adjustment_reversals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

admissions_discharge_complete.name: admissions_discharge_complete
admissions_discharge_complete.value:
("admissions"."discharged_at" IS NULL AND "admissions"."discharged_by" IS NULL AND "admissions"."discharge_disposition" IS NULL)
      OR ("admissions"."discharged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "admissions"."discharged_by" IS NOT NULL AND "admissions"."discharge_disposition" IS NOT NULL)

allocations_reversal.name: allocations_reversal
allocations_reversal.value:
("allocations"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "allocations"."reversed_by" IS NULL AND "allocations"."reversal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("allocations"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."reversed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("allocations"."reversal_reason")) > 0)

cashier_shifts_closing.name: cashier_shifts_closing

charges_source_or_reason.name: charges_source_or_reason

num_nonnulls("charges"."bed_stay_id", "charges"."queue_entry_id", "charges"."order_item_id") <= 1

charges_manual_has_person.name: charges_manual_has_person

      OR ("charges"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "charges"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("charges"."cancellation_reason")) > 0
          AND ("charges"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL OR "charges"."queue_entry_id" IS NOT NULL))

clinical_notes_shape.name: clinical_notes_shape
clinical_notes_shape.value:
("clinical_notes"."kind" = 'consultation' AND "clinical_notes"."text" IS NULL AND "clinical_notes"."addendum_of" IS NULL
          AND num_nonnulls("clinical_notes"."presenting_complaint", "clinical_notes"."history", "clinical_notes"."examination", "clinical_notes"."plan") >= 1)
      OR ("clinical_notes"."kind" = 'nursing' AND "clinical_notes"."text" IS NOT NULL AND "clinical_notes"."addendum_of" IS NULL
          AND num_nonnulls("clinical_notes"."presenting_complaint", "clinical_notes"."history", "clinical_notes"."examination", "clinical_notes"."plan") = 0)
      OR ("clinical_notes"."kind" = 'addendum' AND "clinical_notes"."text" IS NOT NULL AND "clinical_notes"."addendum_of" IS NOT NULL
          AND num_nonnulls("clinical_notes"."presenting_complaint", "clinical_notes"."history", "clinical_notes"."examination", "clinical_notes"."plan") = 0)

clinical_notes_text_present.name: clinical_notes_text_present
clinical_notes_text_present.value:
("clinical_notes"."text" IS NULL OR length(btrim("clinical_notes"."text")) > 0)
      AND ("clinical_notes"."presenting_complaint" IS NULL OR length(btrim("clinical_notes"."presenting_complaint")) > 0)
      AND ("clinical_notes"."history" IS NULL OR length(btrim("clinical_notes"."history")) > 0)
      AND ("clinical_notes"."examination" IS NULL OR length(btrim("clinical_notes"."examination")) > 0)
      AND ("clinical_notes"."plan" IS NULL OR length(btrim("clinical_notes"."plan")) > 0)

clinical_notes_lifecycle.name: clinical_notes_lifecycle
clinical_notes_lifecycle.value:
("clinical_notes"."status" = 'draft' AND "clinical_notes"."signed_at" IS NULL AND "clinical_notes"."discarded_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("clinical_notes"."status" = 'signed' AND "clinical_notes"."signed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "clinical_notes"."discarded_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("clinical_notes"."status" = 'discarded' AND "clinical_notes"."discarded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "clinical_notes"."signed_at" IS NULL)

clinical_notes_error_complete.name: clinical_notes_error_complete
clinical_notes_error_complete.value:
("clinical_notes"."entered_in_error_at" IS NULL AND "clinical_notes"."entered_in_error_by" IS NULL AND "clinical_notes"."entered_in_error_reason" IS NULL)

          AND "clinical_notes"."entered_in_error_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("clinical_notes"."entered_in_error_reason")) > 0)

diagnoses_confirmation.name: diagnoses_confirmation
diagnoses_confirmation.value:
("diagnoses"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "diagnoses"."confirmed_by" IS NULL)
      OR ("diagnoses"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "diagnoses"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "diagnoses"."certainty" = 'confirmed')

diagnoses_end_complete.name: diagnoses_end_complete
diagnoses_end_complete.value:
("diagnoses"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "diagnoses"."ended_by" IS NULL AND "diagnoses"."end_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("diagnoses"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "diagnoses"."ended_by" IS NOT NULL AND "diagnoses"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL)

documents_void_has_reason.name: documents_void_has_reason
documents_void_has_reason.value:
("documents"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "documents"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("documents"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("documents"."void_reason")) > 0)

encounters_lifecycle.name: encounters_lifecycle
encounters_lifecycle.value:
("encounters"."status" = 'open' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "encounters"."closed_by" IS NULL AND "encounters"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("encounters"."status" = 'closed' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."cancel_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("encounters"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "encounters"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "encounters"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "encounters"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("encounters"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

invitations_licence_fits_roles.name: invitations_licence_fits_roles
invitations_licence_fits_roles.value: "invitations"."licence_profession" IS NULL OR (CASE "invitations"."licence_profession" WHEN 'medical_practitioner' THEN "invitations"."roles" && ARRAY['doctor']::text[] WHEN 'clinical_officer' THEN "invitations"."roles" && ARRAY['clinical_officer']::text[] WHEN 'nurse' THEN "invitations"."roles" && ARRAY['nurse', 'ward_nurse']::text[] WHEN 'laboratory' THEN "invitations"."roles" && ARRAY['lab_tech', 'lab_supervisor']::text[] WHEN 'pharmacy' THEN "invitations"."roles" && ARRAY['pharmacist', 'pharm_tech']::text[] ELSE false END)

invitations_licence_iff_clinical.name: invitations_licence_iff_clinical
invitations_licence_iff_clinical.value:
("invitations"."roles" && ARRAY['doctor', 'clinical_officer', 'nurse', 'ward_nurse', 'lab_tech', 'lab_supervisor', 'pharmacist', 'pharm_tech']::text[]) = ("invitations"."licence_number" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("invitations"."licence_number" IS NULL) = ("invitations"."licence_expires_on" IS NULL)
        AND ("invitations"."licence_number" IS NULL) = ("invitations"."licence_profession" IS NULL)

invitations_acceptance_matches_status.name: invitations_acceptance_matches_status
invitations_acceptance_matches_status.value:
("invitations"."status" = 'accepted' AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NULL)

invoice_adjustments_reversal.name: invoice_adjustments_reversal
invoice_adjustments_reversal.value:
("invoice_adjustments"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "invoice_adjustments"."reversed_by" IS NULL AND "invoice_adjustments"."reversal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("invoice_adjustments"."status" = 'approved' AND "invoice_adjustments"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_adjustments"."reversed_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "invoice_adjustments"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("invoice_adjustments"."reversal_reason")) > 0)

invoice_adjustments_decision.name: invoice_adjustments_decision
invoice_adjustments_decision.value:
("invoice_adjustments"."status" = 'pending' AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("invoice_adjustments"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_by" <> "invoice_adjustments"."requested_by")
      OR ("invoice_adjustments"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_by" = "invoice_adjustments"."requested_by" AND "invoice_adjustments"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_lifecycle.name: invoices_lifecycle
invoices_lifecycle.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'draft' AND "invoices"."total_cents" IS NULL AND "invoices"."document_id" IS NULL AND "invoices"."finalised_at" IS NULL
          AND "invoices"."finalised_by" IS NULL AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "invoices"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("invoices"."status" = 'finalised' AND "invoices"."total_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."document_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."finalised_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."finalised_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "invoices"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("invoices"."status" = 'void' AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invoices"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("invoices"."void_reason")) > 0)

lab_analytes_shape.name: lab_analytes_shape
lab_analytes_shape.value:
("lab_analytes"."result_type" = 'numeric' AND "lab_analytes"."choices" IS NULL AND "lab_analytes"."abnormal_choices" IS NULL
          AND ("lab_analytes"."unit" IS NULL OR length(btrim("lab_analytes"."unit")) > 0)
          AND ("lab_analytes"."critical_low" IS NULL OR "lab_analytes"."critical_high" IS NULL OR "lab_analytes"."critical_low" < "lab_analytes"."critical_high"))
      OR ("lab_analytes"."result_type" = 'choice' AND "lab_analytes"."unit" IS NULL AND "lab_analytes"."critical_low" IS NULL AND "lab_analytes"."critical_high" IS NULL
          AND "lab_analytes"."choices" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("lab_analytes"."choices") >= 2
          AND "lab_analytes"."abnormal_choices" IS NOT NULL AND "lab_analytes"."abnormal_choices" <@ "lab_analytes"."choices")
      OR ("lab_analytes"."result_type" = 'text' AND "lab_analytes"."unit" IS NULL AND "lab_analytes"."choices" IS NULL AND "lab_analytes"."abnormal_choices" IS NULL
          AND "lab_analytes"."critical_low" IS NULL AND "lab_analytes"."critical_high" IS NULL)

lab_reference_ranges_bounds.name: lab_reference_ranges_bounds
lab_reference_ranges_bounds.value: num_nonnulls("lab_reference_ranges"."low", "lab_reference_ranges"."high") >= 1 AND ("lab_reference_ranges"."low" IS NULL OR "lab_reference_ranges"."high" IS NULL OR "lab_reference_ranges"."low" < "lab_reference_ranges"."high")

lab_result_values_shape.name: lab_result_values_shape
lab_result_values_shape.value:
("lab_result_values"."result_type" = 'numeric' AND "lab_result_values"."value_numeric" IS NOT NULL AND "lab_result_values"."value_text" IS NULL)
      OR ("lab_result_values"."result_type" <> 'numeric' AND "lab_result_values"."value_text" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("lab_result_values"."value_text")) > 0
          AND num_nonnulls("lab_result_values"."value_numeric", "lab_result_values"."unit", "lab_result_values"."range_low", "lab_result_values"."range_high", "lab_result_values"."critical_low", "lab_result_values"."critical_high") = 0
          AND ("lab_result_values"."flag" IS NULL OR "lab_result_values"."flag" = 'abnormal'))

lab_results_correction_reason.name: lab_results_correction_reason
lab_results_correction_reason.value:
("lab_results"."version" = 1) = ("lab_results"."correction_reason" IS NULL)
      AND ("lab_results"."correction_reason" IS NULL OR length(btrim("lab_results"."correction_reason")) > 0)

lab_results_lifecycle.name: lab_results_lifecycle
lab_results_lifecycle.value:
num_nonnulls("lab_results"."released_at", "lab_results"."released_by", "lab_results"."release_reason") IN (0, 3)
      AND num_nonnulls("lab_results"."verified_at", "lab_results"."verified_by") IN (0, 2)
      AND ("lab_results"."release_reason" IS NULL OR length(btrim("lab_results"."release_reason")) > 0)
      AND CASE "lab_results"."status"
            WHEN 'entered' THEN num_nonnulls("lab_results"."released_at", "lab_results"."verified_at", "lab_results"."superseded_at") = 0
            WHEN 'released' THEN "lab_results"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("lab_results"."verified_at", "lab_results"."superseded_at") = 0
            WHEN 'verified' THEN "lab_results"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lab_results"."superseded_at" IS NULL
            ELSE "lab_results"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL
          END

lab_results_told.name: lab_results_told
lab_results_told.value:
num_nonnulls("lab_results"."told_name", "lab_results"."told_how", "lab_results"."told_at", "lab_results"."told_recorded_by") IN (0, 4)
      AND ("lab_results"."told_name" IS NULL OR length(btrim("lab_results"."told_name")) > 0)
      AND (NOT "lab_results"."has_critical" OR "lab_results"."released_at" IS NULL AND "lab_results"."verified_at" IS NULL OR "lab_results"."told_name" IS NOT NULL)

memberships_licence_fits_roles.name: memberships_licence_fits_roles
memberships_licence_fits_roles.value: "memberships"."licence_profession" IS NULL OR (CASE "memberships"."licence_profession" WHEN 'medical_practitioner' THEN "memberships"."roles" && ARRAY['doctor']::text[] WHEN 'clinical_officer' THEN "memberships"."roles" && ARRAY['clinical_officer']::text[] WHEN 'nurse' THEN "memberships"."roles" && ARRAY['nurse', 'ward_nurse']::text[] WHEN 'laboratory' THEN "memberships"."roles" && ARRAY['lab_tech', 'lab_supervisor']::text[] WHEN 'pharmacy' THEN "memberships"."roles" && ARRAY['pharmacist', 'pharm_tech']::text[] ELSE false END)

memberships_licence_iff_clinical.name: memberships_licence_iff_clinical
memberships_licence_iff_clinical.value:
("memberships"."roles" && ARRAY['doctor', 'clinical_officer', 'nurse', 'ward_nurse', 'lab_tech', 'lab_supervisor', 'pharmacist', 'pharm_tech']::text[]) = ("memberships"."licence_number" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("memberships"."licence_number" IS NULL) = ("memberships"."licence_expires_on" IS NULL)
        AND ("memberships"."licence_number" IS NULL) = ("memberships"."licence_profession" IS NULL)

mpesa_stk_requests_lifecycle.name: mpesa_stk_requests_lifecycle
mpesa_stk_requests_lifecycle.value:
("mpesa_stk_requests"."status" IN ('queued', 'sending') AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."checkout_request_id" IS NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."mpesa_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("mpesa_stk_requests"."status" = 'sent' AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."checkout_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."mpesa_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("mpesa_stk_requests"."status" = 'completed' AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."checkout_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."mpesa_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("mpesa_stk_requests"."status" = 'failed' AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."mpesa_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "mpesa_stk_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

observations_value_plausible.name: observations_value_plausible
observations_value_plausible.value: CASE "observations"."code" WHEN 'temperature' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 25 AND 45 WHEN 'pulse' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 20 AND 300 WHEN 'respiratory_rate' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 2 AND 90 WHEN 'bp_systolic' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 40 AND 300 WHEN 'bp_diastolic' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 20 AND 200 WHEN 'spo2' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 40 AND 100 WHEN 'weight' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 0.3 AND 400 WHEN 'height' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 20 AND 250 WHEN 'muac' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 5 AND 60 WHEN 'blood_glucose' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 0.5 AND 60 WHEN 'pain_score' THEN "observations"."value" BETWEEN 0 AND 10 ELSE false END

observations_error_complete.name: observations_error_complete
observations_error_complete.value:
("observations"."entered_in_error_at" IS NULL AND "observations"."entered_in_error_by" IS NULL AND "observations"."entered_in_error_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("observations"."entered_in_error_at" IS NOT NULL AND "observations"."entered_in_error_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "observations"."entered_in_error_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("observations"."entered_in_error_reason")) > 0)

order_items_medication_shape.name: order_items_medication_shape
order_items_medication_shape.value:
("order_items"."drug_code" IS NULL AND num_nonnulls("order_items"."drug_description", "order_items"."dose_amount", "order_items"."dose_unit", "order_items"."route", "order_items"."frequency",
          "order_items"."duration_days", "order_items"."quantity", "order_items"."instructions", "order_items"."allergy_override_reason") = 0)
      OR ("order_items"."drug_code" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."drug_description" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."dose_unit" IS NOT NULL
          AND "order_items"."route" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."frequency" IS NOT NULL
          AND "order_items"."dose_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."dose_amount" > 0 AND "order_items"."quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."quantity" > 0
          AND CASE "order_items"."frequency"
                WHEN 'stat' THEN "order_items"."duration_days" IS NULL
                WHEN 'prn' THEN "order_items"."duration_days" IS NULL OR "order_items"."duration_days" > 0
                ELSE "order_items"."duration_days" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."duration_days" > 0
              END
          AND ("order_items"."instructions" IS NULL OR length(btrim("order_items"."instructions")) > 0)
          AND ("order_items"."allergy_override_reason" IS NULL OR length(btrim("order_items"."allergy_override_reason")) > 0))

order_items_lifecycle.name: order_items_lifecycle
order_items_lifecycle.value:
("order_items"."status" = 'ordered' AND num_nonnulls("order_items"."done_at", "order_items"."done_by", "order_items"."cancelled_at", "order_items"."cancelled_by", "order_items"."cancellation_reason") = 0)
      OR ("order_items"."status" = 'done' AND "order_items"."done_at" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."done_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND num_nonnulls("order_items"."cancelled_at", "order_items"."cancelled_by", "order_items"."cancellation_reason") = 0)
      OR ("order_items"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "order_items"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "order_items"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "order_items"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("order_items"."cancellation_reason")) > 0
          AND num_nonnulls("order_items"."done_at", "order_items"."done_by") = 0)

orders_prescription_prescribed.name: orders_prescription_prescribed
orders_prescription_prescribed.value: "orders"."document_id" IS NULL OR "orders"."ordered_by" IS NOT NULL

orders_one_requester.name: orders_one_requester
orders_one_requester.value:
num_nonnulls("orders"."ordered_by", "orders"."requester_name") + "orders"."self_requested"::int = 1
      AND ("orders"."requester_name" IS NULL) = ("orders"."requester_facility" IS NULL)
      AND ("orders"."requester_licence" IS NULL OR "orders"."requester_name" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("orders"."ordered_by" IS NULL OR "orders"."ordered_by" = "orders"."entered_by")

orders_text_present.name: orders_text_present
orders_text_present.value:
("orders"."indication" IS NULL OR length(btrim("orders"."indication")) > 0)
      AND ("orders"."requester_name" IS NULL OR length(btrim("orders"."requester_name")) > 0)
      AND ("orders"."requester_facility" IS NULL OR length(btrim("orders"."requester_facility")) > 0)
      AND ("orders"."requester_licence" IS NULL OR length(btrim("orders"."requester_licence")) > 0)

patient_allergies_allergen_unless_none_k.name: patient_allergies_allergen_unless_none_known
patient_allergies_allergen_unless_none_k.value:
("patient_allergies"."category" = 'none_known' AND "patient_allergies"."allergen" IS NULL AND "patient_allergies"."reaction" IS NULL AND "patient_allergies"."severity" IS NULL)
      OR ("patient_allergies"."category" <> 'none_known' AND "patient_allergies"."allergen" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("patient_allergies"."allergen")) > 0)

patient_allergies_removal_complete.name: patient_allergies_removal_complete
patient_allergies_removal_complete.value:
("patient_allergies"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "patient_allergies"."removed_by" IS NULL AND "patient_allergies"."removal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("patient_allergies"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "patient_allergies"."removed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "patient_allergies"."removal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

patients_unidentified_reasons.name: patients_unidentified_reasons
patients_unidentified_reasons.value: ("patients"."no_phone_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'unidentified' AND "patients"."no_id_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'unidentified') OR "patients"."unidentified"

payments_reference.name: payments_reference
payments_reference.value:
("payments"."method" = 'cash' AND "payments"."reference" IS NULL)
      OR ("payments"."method" <> 'cash' AND "payments"."reference" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("payments"."reference")) > 0)

payments_reversal.name: payments_reversal
payments_reversal.value:
("payments"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "payments"."reversed_by" IS NULL AND "payments"."reversal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("payments"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."reversed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("payments"."reversal_reason")) > 0
          AND ("payments"."received_by" IS NULL OR "payments"."reversed_by" <> "payments"."received_by"))

price_changes_decision.name: price_changes_decision
price_changes_decision.value:
("price_changes"."status" = 'pending' AND "price_changes"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "price_changes"."decided_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("price_changes"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "price_changes"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "price_changes"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "price_changes"."decided_by" <> "price_changes"."requested_by")
      OR ("price_changes"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "price_changes"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "price_changes"."decided_by" = "price_changes"."requested_by" AND "price_changes"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

queue_entries_lifecycle.name: queue_entries_lifecycle
queue_entries_lifecycle.value:
("queue_entries"."status" = 'waiting' AND "queue_entries"."serving_at" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."served_by" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_by" IS NULL)
      OR ("queue_entries"."status" = 'serving' AND "queue_entries"."serving_at" IS NOT NULL AND "queue_entries"."served_by" IS NOT NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_by" IS NULL)
      OR ("queue_entries"."status" = 'done' AND "queue_entries"."serving_at" IS NOT NULL AND "queue_entries"."served_by" IS NOT NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("queue_entries"."status" = 'left' AND "queue_entries"."serving_at" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."served_by" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("queue_entries"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "queue_entries"."serving_at" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."served_by" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "queue_entries"."ended_by" IS NOT NULL)

queue_entries_in_order.name: queue_entries_in_order
queue_entries_in_order.value:
("queue_entries"."serving_at" IS NULL OR "queue_entries"."serving_at" >= "queue_entries"."joined_at")
      AND ("queue_entries"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "queue_entries"."ended_at" >= coalesce("queue_entries"."serving_at", "queue_entries"."joined_at"))

refunds_decision.name: refunds_decision
refunds_decision.value:
("refunds"."status" = 'pending' AND "refunds"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "refunds"."decided_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("refunds"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "refunds"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "refunds"."decided_by" <> "refunds"."requested_by")
      OR ("refunds"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "refunds"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."decided_by" = "refunds"."requested_by" AND "refunds"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

refunds_payout.name: refunds_payout
refunds_payout.value:
("refunds"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "refunds"."paid_by" IS NULL AND "refunds"."method" IS NULL AND "refunds"."reference" IS NULL
        AND "refunds"."cashier_shift_id" IS NULL AND "refunds"."document_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("refunds"."status" = 'approved' AND "refunds"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."paid_by" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."document_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "refunds"."method" IS NOT NULL
        AND (("refunds"."method" = 'cash' AND "refunds"."reference" IS NULL AND "refunds"."cashier_shift_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("refunds"."method" = 'card' AND "refunds"."reference" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("refunds"."reference")) > 0 AND "refunds"."cashier_shift_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("refunds"."method" IN ('bank', 'mpesa') AND "refunds"."reference" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("refunds"."reference")) > 0 AND "refunds"."cashier_shift_id" IS NULL)))

refunds_reversal.name: refunds_reversal
refunds_reversal.value:
("refunds"."reversed_at" IS NULL AND "refunds"."reversed_by" IS NULL AND "refunds"."reversal_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("refunds"."status" = 'approved' AND "refunds"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."reversed_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND "refunds"."reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("refunds"."reversal_reason")) > 0
        AND ("refunds"."paid_by" IS NULL OR "refunds"."reversed_by" <> "refunds"."paid_by"))

specimens_lifecycle.name: specimens_lifecycle
specimens_lifecycle.value:
("specimens"."status" = 'collected' AND num_nonnulls("specimens"."received_at", "specimens"."received_by", "specimens"."rejected_at", "specimens"."rejected_by", "specimens"."rejection_reason", "specimens"."rejection_note") = 0)
      OR ("specimens"."status" = 'received' AND "specimens"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "specimens"."received_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND num_nonnulls("specimens"."rejected_at", "specimens"."rejected_by", "specimens"."rejection_reason", "specimens"."rejection_note") = 0)
      OR ("specimens"."status" = 'rejected' AND "specimens"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "specimens"."rejected_by" IS NOT NULL AND "specimens"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND ("specimens"."received_at" IS NULL) = ("specimens"."received_by" IS NULL))

specimens_rejection_note.name: specimens_rejection_note
specimens_rejection_note.value:
("specimens"."rejection_note" IS NULL OR length(btrim("specimens"."rejection_note")) > 0)
      AND ("specimens"."rejection_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other' OR "specimens"."rejection_note" IS NOT NULL)

specimens_in_order.name: specimens_in_order
specimens_in_order.value:
("specimens"."received_at" IS NULL OR "specimens"."received_at" >= "specimens"."collected_at")
      AND ("specimens"."rejected_at" IS NULL OR "specimens"."rejected_at" >= "specimens"."collected_at")
